fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects suspicious Windows Error Reporting manager (wermgr.exe) child process
fields.name: Suspicious Child Process Of Wermgr.EXE
fields.notes:
- To move around freely without attracting too much attention, attackers often use reliable software (one of the favorites is psexec) that looks normal in an enterprise environment.
- Use the following aggregate to easily group by endpoint: `| group array_agg_distinct(dst.ip.address) by endpoint.name, src.process.cmdline`
fields.query:
event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((src.process.image.path contains "\wermgr.exe" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "\cmd.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\cscript.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\ipconfig.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\mshta.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "
et.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "
et1.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "
etstat.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "
slookup.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\powershell_ise.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\powershell.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\pwsh.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "egsvr32.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "undll32.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\systeminfo.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\whoami.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\wscript.exe")) and (not (tgt.process.image.path contains "undll32.exe" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "C:\Windows\system32\WerConCpl.dll" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "LaunchErcApp ") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "-queuereporting" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "-responsepester")))))
